finding_info.title: Check if S3 buckets have public access

status_detail: S3 Bucket customer-uploads-prod has public read access enabled via bucket policy.
risk_details: Publicly readable storage can expose customer data to anyone on the internet.

remediation.desc: Block public access at the bucket and account level; scope access via IAM/bucket policy instead.

finding_info.title: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account

status_detail: Root account does not have MFA enabled.
risk_details: Root account compromise without MFA gives an attacker unrestricted control of the AWS account.

remediation.desc: Enable a hardware or virtual MFA device on the root account immediately.

finding_info.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22

status_detail: Security group sg-0a1b2c3d (bastion-sg) allows SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0.
risk_details: Open SSH to the internet is a primary vector for brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks.

remediation.desc: Restrict SSH ingress to known IP ranges or a bastion/VPN, never 0.0.0.0/0.

finding_info.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions

status_detail: CloudTrail trail 'org-trail' is multi-region and logging.

finding_info.title: Ensure RDS instances have automated backups enabled

status_detail: RDS instance prod-orders-db has automated backups disabled (retention period 0).
risk_details: No automated backups means data loss risk on instance failure or accidental deletion.

remediation.desc: Set backup retention period to at least 7 days.

finding_info.title: Ensure IAM password policy requires an uppercase letter

status_detail: Account password policy does not require an uppercase character.
risk_details: Weaker password policy increases the odds of a guessable IAM user password.

remediation.desc: Update the account password policy to require uppercase, lowercase, number and symbol.

finding_info.title: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs

status_detail: VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d has flow logs enabled to CloudWatch Logs.
